title: When the Gravity Turns
author: Beatrix Dunmore
blurb: Coral Nystrom, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
